name: What is the typical timeline for professional drywall repair in a foreclosed home?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for professional drywall repair in a foreclosed home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for professional drywall repair depends on the scope of work. Small patches and minor repairs might take one to two days, including drying time for joint compound and paint. Larger projects involving multiple rooms, extensive water damage remediation, or full panel replacements can extend to several days or even over a week. The drying and curing of materials are critical steps that cannot be rushed. We provide an estimated timeline with your project quote.
acceptedAnswer.description: The timeline for drywall repair varies by scope: small jobs take 1-2 days, while extensive projects can last several days to over a week, including drying time.
